title: Fynkel Animator Controller
description: `<name>.controller.json` (ADR-0032): Unity's Animator Controller — parameters, and per layer a state machine of states (each playing an animation clip or a blend space) and transitions between them on conditions over the parameters. A `fynkel.Animator` names it in `controller`; the engine runs it every tick, and gameplay code only sets parameters (`setFloat`, `setBool`, `setTrigger`) or jumps to a state by name (`play`, `crossFade`).

parameter.description: A value the transitions test and code sets. Each animator has its own copy, starting at `default`.

name.description: What code and conditions call it (`speed`).

type.description: `trigger`: a bool that the transition it fires sets back to false (Unity's Trigger).

default.description: The starting value: a number for `float` and `int`, `true`/`false` for `bool`; a trigger starts unset. Absent: 0 or false.

state.description: A state plays one motion while it is the layer's current state. With `states` instead of a motion it is a sub-state machine (ADR-0033 § 4): drawn as one box, a transition into it enters its `defaultState`, and a transition from it is checked from every state inside it.

name.description: Unique in its layer (or its sub-state machine); what transitions and `play('Jump')` name. Not `any`, no `/`: code names a state inside a sub-state machine by path (`Airborne/Fall`).

motion.description: An animation clip (a model's or a rig's `anim/<n>`), a blend space (`.blend.json`) or a blend tree. Absent: the state holds the pose (Unity's empty state).

speedParameter.description: A float parameter the speed is multiplied by.

rootMotion.description: Whether its root motion moves the character. Absent: the Animator's `root_motion`.

defaultState.description: A sub-state machine's: the state a transition into it enters. Required when it has states.

states.description: A sub-state machine's states (at most 8 deep).

transitions.description: A sub-state machine's transitions between its own states (not `any`: Any State's belong to the layer).

blendTree.description: Several motions mixed by parameters (ADR-0033, Unity's blend tree). Every child shares the state's normalized time; the state's length is the children's weighted by the tree. The weights follow Unity's methods.

type.description: `1d`: children at a `threshold` along one parameter. `simpleDirectional`: 2D, one child per direction plus one at the centre. `freeformDirectional`: 2D, several children per direction (walk and run every way). `freeformCartesian`: 2D, where the two values are not a direction. `direct`: each child's own `parameter` is its weight.

parameters.description: The float parameters it reads: one for `1d`, two (x, y) for the 2D types, none for `direct`.

motion.description: A clip, a blend space or another blend tree (at most 4 deep).

threshold.description: A `1d` tree's: where on the parameter it plays alone.

position.description: A 2D tree's: `[x, y]` where it plays alone.

timeScale.description: How much faster its clock runs than the tree's.

parameter.description: A `direct` tree's: the float parameter that is its weight.

condition.description: One test of a parameter: `greater`/`less` for a float or an int, `equals`/`notEquals` for an int, `is` for a bool, nothing more for a trigger (it holds while the trigger is set).

transition.description: From a state (or `any`: Any State) to another, when every condition holds and, with an exit time, once the state has played that far. Any State's transitions are checked first, then those from the sub-state machines the state is in (outer first), then the state's own, each in file order; one fires per tick, and none while a transition's crossfade runs unless `interruptibleBy` allows it.

from.description: A state's name (in the same layer or sub-state machine as the transition), or `any`.

to.description: A state's name; a sub-state machine's enters its default state.

exitTime.description: The fraction of the state's motion that must have played (0.9 = 90 %, 1.5 = halfway through the second loop). Without conditions the transition fires then.

offset.description: Where the next state's motion starts, as a fraction of it.

canTransitionToSelf.description: Any State only: whether it may fire into the state already playing (restarting it).

interruptibleBy.description: What may cut its crossfade short: `none` (it always ends first), `next` (the transitions of the state it goes to), `any` (Any State's and the next state's). An interruption fades from the pose of that moment, held, so nothing pops.

layer.description: A state machine. The first layer is the base; each next one is applied over the ones below.

weight.description: How much of it shows over the layers below (the base layer is always whole).

blending.description: `override`: its pose replaces what is below, by `weight`; `additive`: its motion's change from its first frame is added.

root.description: The node it poses from (`spine`): it poses only that node and those under it. Absent: the whole character.

defaultState.description: The state the layer starts in (Unity's orange state). Required when there are states.

editor.description: Where the Animator window draws each state, by layer name then state name: `[x, y]`. The runtime never reads it.
